category_override_reason: Cluster was labeled AUDIO_FAIL. The real per-turn cause is a turn-level overall_tool_invocation_correctness FAIL on the verify_passcode/put_account_on_test turn (turn 3), driven by a parameter-value mismatch — not a missing tool and not a text mismatch. Closest standard category is TOOL_MISSING/EXPECTATION_FAIL (tool-invocation scoring), but the underlying fix is eval-side. Surface label kept descriptive as a tool-invocation-correctness failure.
root_cause: DETERMINISTIC, SHARED across both goldens: the golden hard-codes verify_passcode args with passcode: "Bluebird" (capital B) as an EXACT-match assertion (no $matchType: ignore, and the eval threshold is overall_tool_invocation_correctness_threshold: 1, tool_invocation_parameter_correctness_threshold: 1). In the AUDIO channel the gemini-3.1-flash-live model normalizes the spoken passcode to lowercase and emits verify_passcode(passcode="bluebird"). The platform parameter scorer marks passcode "bluebird" != "Bluebird" -> verify_passcode scores 0, put_account_on_test scores 1 -> turn 3 overall_tool_invocation_score = 0.5 -> turn FAILS the threshold of 1.0 -> whole golden FAILS, in every run, even though every custom expectation and every semantic-similarity score PASS. The agent behavior is correct (the verify_passcode tool itself compares case-insensitively: `passcode.strip().lower() == record['passcode'].lower()`, so verification succeeds and the flow completes). TEXT channel passes 3/3 because typed input preserves the capital 'B', so the exact-match assertion holds. This is the ONLY failure cause that is present in ALL 3 runs of BOTH evals, so it alone accounts for the 0/3 + 0/3.
secondary_findings: ASR variance on 'Bluebird' (heard as 'Blueberg' / 'Luber') is real but NOT the deciding cause: in uc2 run 1 and run 2 and all declined runs the model still emitted the correct passcode 'bluebird' and verification succeeded. Only uc2 run 0 actually failed verification end-to-end (3 wrong attempts -> escalation to live operator); that run would fail anyway, but it is just 1 of 6 runs.

Flaky end_session in audio: uc2 run 1 turn 5, the agent spoke the closing ('You're all set. Have a good day.') but did NOT call end_session -> turn 5 tool score 0 -> FAIL. Runs 0 and 2 of uc2 DID call end_session. The after_model_callback only injects farewell TEXT when end_session is silent; it does not force the end_session call. This is a real but secondary/flaky issue (1/3) and is masked by the deterministic turn-3 failure. Fixing turn 3 will not by itself make uc2 pass 3/3 unless the end_session flakiness is also addressed (trigger pattern) — but it is NOT the cluster-wide blocker and the declined eval does not even have an end_session turn.
duration_minutes is correct (60) and duration_label is $ignore'd in the golden, so the duration handling is NOT a problem. put_account_on_test consistently matches (score 1).

Is the golden expectation stale / over-strict vs demonstrably-correct agent behavior? -> YES: tool verifies case-insensitively and the flow completes; the golden's exact-cased passcode literal is the thing breaking audio

fix_summary_one_line: In goldens.yaml, relax the verify_passcode `passcode` arg assertion to case-insensitive/ignore (add $matchType: ignore like account_id, or use a case-insensitive match) in BOTH uc2_on_test_disambiguation_sms_happy_path (turn 4) and sms_offered_after_validation_then_declined (turn 4) so the audio model's lowercased 'bluebird' matches; secondarily, address flaky end_session in uc2 (trigger pattern / accept end_session arrives via callback) if 3/3 is required.
shared_vs_split_rationale: SHARED: both goldens use caller +12145550199 / passcode 'Bluebird' and both fail on the same turn (verify_passcode + put_account_on_test) for the same reason — exact-cased passcode literal vs audio-normalized lowercase. Quotes from both transcripts (uc2 run1 and declined run0) show identical passcode='bluebird' emission and identical 0.5 turn score.
